content:
oliver: Heads-up from support: customer noticed a burst of provisional tokens when a streaming request hit a quota-enforced path and the client retried. trace=qb-77

june: Can you share the short log?

oliver: ```
[2026-01-18T11:22:10Z] stream.start session=s-101 route=us-central quota_path=standard prefetched=false
[2026-01-18T11:22:11Z] toolcall.start id=tc-901 provisional=pv-1001
[2026-01-18T11:22:12Z] quota.enforce path=standard decision=throttle -> client-rate-limit
[2026-01-18T11:22:13Z] client.retry reason=throttled invocation=inv-42
[2026-01-18T11:22:14Z] toolcall.start id=tc-902 provisional=pv-1002 invocation=inv-42
[2026-01-18T11:22:15Z] toolcall.confirm invocation=inv-42 confirmed_tokens=280
```

sam: So provisional double for same invocation_id because throttled retry re-issued provisional before confirm. Ledger dedupe only by provisional id currently.

raj: Interesting wrinkle: quota enforcement happens before we check for existing provisionals, so throttle->retry race creates duplicate provisional. Two levers: change ordering (check dedupe before quota) OR make quota policy understand provisional-reservation state.

june: UI/telemetry ask: console quota dashboard should show provisional reservations that are pending vs applied so PMs can see throttling interactions. Add a small timeline per request showing quota decisions.

ops-bot: Runbook note created: runbook/quota/provisional-throttle-race. Owner: sam. ETA 48h.

sam: Short-term mitigation: if retry arrives within M ms and has same invocation id, reuse provisional (server-side reuse). Implement as hotfix guarded by feature flag. Emit header `x-provisional-reused`.

raj: Long-term: audit path: 1) move ledger dedupe check before hard quota enforcement for streaming paths (careful: could allow soft reservations to bypass quota surge). 2) add `provisional_reserved` state in quota service to account for pending provisional reservations and decrement soft-available tokens. That lets quota service block retries that would double-reserve.

june: For rollout UX: do shadow run of `x-provisional-reused` on 2% traffic for 6h, surface `provisional_reuse_rate` metric. Console will add a toggle to include provisional reservations in quota charts.

sam: Also add telemetry field `quota_decision_chain` listing {pre_dequeue, post_dequeue, provisional_check} so we can trace ordering per request.

billing-bot: Alert suppressed: provisional_dup_detected customer=bigco count=1.

oliver: Action items: sam implement flagged hotfix + shadow, june add console timeline card, raj spec long-term quota/provisional interaction doc, ops-bot create incident INC-2026-013.

june: I'll draft messaging for customers explaining provisional semantics and that we're shadowing a fix. :thumbsup:
